verdict.rationale: An identity verification SaaS could plausibly offer in-product AI insights or suggestions, so the axis applies. The evidence covers only verification reports (Document, Facial Similarity, Known Faces, Watchlist), the no-code Workflow Studio, and API, webhook and SDK mechanics. Per-applicant check results such as Known Faces repeat-fraud alerts are an adjacent feature, not AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from the user's data, and nothing describes an AI insights or recommendations capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
